description: Add the 7 curated 2026-11 architecture patterns and failure modes to holon-knowledge/kb/{patterns,failure_modes}/ with zero harness references.
goal: Add the 7 KB-*.json entries under holon-knowledge/kb/patterns/ and holon-knowledge/kb/failure_modes/ covering worktree git hardening (KB-pattern-worktree-git-hardening.json), hermetic pytest conftest guards (KB-pattern-hermetic-pytest-conftest.json), append-only 3-ledger fragment routing (KB-pattern-three-ledger-fragment-routing.json), bidirectional flow/entrypoint and ledger/knowledge import cycles (KB-failure-bidirectional-flow-entrypoint-cycle.json), monolithic review-loop complexity (KB-failure-monolithic-review-loop-complexity.json), env-registry runtime drift (KB-failure-env-registry-runtime-drift.json), and container resource limits and secret perm gaps (KB-failure-container-resource-and-secret-perm-gaps.json), each conforming to docs/knowledgebase_schema.md (version 1.0, created_by architecture-audit-2026-11, human_approved true, valid schema fields and zero harness references). Add apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_architecture_audit_kb_entries.py asserting sandbox_executor.knowledge.wisdom.load_index() loads all 7 entries cleanly with valid schemas and zero harness path leaks, and run uv run pytest and uv run task lint. Code is self-explaining: no docstrings and no comments except '# why:' comments that record a reason the code cannot show.
rationale: Persisting validated architectural patterns and failure modes inside target-native holon-knowledge/kb/ gives Stage 2 planners and Stage 4 reviewers machine-readable design guidance without touching any runtime module.
acceptance_criteria: All 7 KB-*.json files above (KB-pattern-worktree-git-hardening.json, KB-pattern-hermetic-pytest-conftest.json, KB-pattern-three-ledger-fragment-routing.json, KB-failure-bidirectional-flow-entrypoint-cycle.json, KB-failure-monolithic-review-loop-complexity.json, KB-failure-env-registry-runtime-drift.json, and KB-failure-container-resource-and-secret-perm-gaps.json) are committed under holon-knowledge/kb/{patterns,failure_modes}/ via holon flow targeting holon-agentic-coder.
sandbox_executor.knowledge.wisdom.load_index() loads every entry cleanly with zero schema/JSON errors and zero harness path leaks.
apps/sandbox-executor/tests/test_architecture_audit_kb_entries.py passes uv run pytest and uv run task lint passes with zero docstrings or disallowed comments.
